description: Fact-recovery tasks about the persistent pi-cbmem MCP implementation in this repository.

tasks.question: From the supplied evidence, report the bridge executable as a home-relative path, the MCP transport label, and the CBM_LOG_LEVEL value.

Inspect pi-cbmem and identify both destructive operations that require confirmation and the two Pi modes where confirmation is allowed. Normalize the operation answers as tool or tool:mode and modes as a comma-separated list in source order.
Inspect pi-cbmem and report its maximum output lines, maximum output size label, and the helper that extracts direct text from MCP content. Return the helper exactly as written in source.

Inspect pi-cbmem and report the MCP request-cancellation method, whether cancelling one tool call closes the persistent session, and the MCP initialization timeout in milliseconds. Normalize the close answer as yes or no.
